fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM94,535. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0008605/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Credit in any THREE (3) subjects at SPM/SPMV level and a Pass in Science and Mathematics; Pass Certificate recognized by the Ministry of Health’s Department of Traditional & Contemporary Medicine (T&CM) plus one year working experience in a relevant field; PTPL Certificate in a relevant field; Other equivalent qualifications recognized by MSU Senate.
